payload.question: Do council homes have an up-to-date gas safety check?
payload.label: Council homes with a valid gas safety certificate, Q1 2025/26
payload.council_caveat: The council blames "contractor personnel changes with new service personnel required to complete mandatory training" and changes to court timetables for the warrants it needs to get into homes where nobody answers. It says both are fixed. The council publishes these numbers as screenshots of a dashboard inside a PDF, so they cannot be read by machine. We read them off the images by eye, which is why this measure is flagged for human checking.
payload.evidence: The law requires a gas safety check every year in every council home with a gas supply. Norwich's target is 100% and it says it will step in below 99.8%. In the first quarter of 2025/26 it was at 99.95% — a handful of homes short of every one.

ai.reviewed_by: two independent AI review passes, reconciled against the source documents, 8 September 2026
